wristband_code.title: Wristband Code
wristband_code.description: What the scanner read from the wristband (the MRN, or HMS:PT:<mrn>)

identity_check.title: Identity Check
identity_check.description: Without a scan: TwoIdentifiers (name and date of birth or MRN asked), or EmergencyOverride (an emergency patient who cannot be identified yet; identity_note required)

site_confirmed.title: Site Confirmed
site_confirmed.description: InProgress: the site and side checked against the order

pregnancy_status.title: Pregnancy Status
pregnancy_status.description: InProgress: required for a woman of 10 to 55 before X-ray, CT, fluoroscopy or mammography (`pregnancy_check_needed` of the worklist)

pregnancy_note.title: Pregnancy Note
pregnancy_note.description: Required for Pregnant: what was decided and by whom

contrast.title: Contrast
contrast.description: Completed: the contrast given (agent, dose, route)

contrast_doctor_id.title: Contrast Doctor Id
contrast_doctor_id.description: Completed with contrast: the employee_id of the doctor present, registered with the PMDC (GET /staff/lookup?license_type=PMDC; never a user_id)
